content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

Conventional platforms like Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle promise simplicity. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery for you. But they also control your access. If their payment processors (Stripe, PayPal) reject your region, the entire system collapses. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, on the other hand, gives you full ownership. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys a combination of Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. You own the code. You control the data. No platform can shut you down. The tradeoff? You must configure the stack yourself—or pay someone to do it. But once deployed, the system runs without recurring fees or platform dependencies. It’s infrastructure you own, not rent.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms rely on Stripe and PayPal for payments. Both exclude Nigeria and other regions due to perceived regulatory or financial risk. Even if a platform claims to support your country, their payment processors will still reject your transactions. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses this entirely. NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. Buyers send payment directly to your wallet. The system verifies the transaction on-chain and delivers the font file automatically. No intermediaries. No compliance teams. No geographic restrictions. The architecture is designed to function in regions where conventional platforms fail. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative built at the base layer.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms charge 5-10% per transaction. They also hold your funds for days or weeks. Stripe, for example, freezes accounts in restricted regions without warning. With sovereign infrastructure, payments settle directly in your crypto wallet within minutes. NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is the only cost. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost is deployment. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack is $197. But you pay this once. After deployment, the system operates without recurring fees. Compare this to platforms that charge monthly subscriptions or per-transaction fees indefinitely. Sovereign infrastructure is more expensive upfront but cheaper long-term. It’s an investment in ownership, not a rental agreement.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you ownership, not dependency.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With conventional platforms, you’re renting access to someone else’s infrastructure. They can change their terms, increase fees, or shut down your account at any time. Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership. COREMERCH deploys the stack, loads your products, and hands over the keys. They have no access after delivery. The system automates everything: payment verification, order storage, and file delivery. When a buyer sends crypto, NOWPayments confirms the transaction on-chain. Cloudflare Workers updates the order in Supabase. The buyer receives a secure download link via email. The entire process runs without your intervention. You own the code, the data, and the workflow. It’s infrastructure sovereignty—not dependency.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you need a quick solution and can use Stripe or PayPal, conventional platforms are simpler. But if you’re in Nigeria or another restricted region, they’re not an option. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent alternative. Choose COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack if you’re ready to own your system. It’s ideal for selling fonts, templates, or other digital products. The upfront cost is higher, but the long-term savings and ownership are undeniable. If you’re not technical, hire someone to deploy the stack for you. Once it’s live, the system runs itself. You’re no longer at the mercy of platforms that exclude you. You’ve built infrastructure that works anywhere—because you own it.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose a domain name and register it with Cloudflare. 2. Purchase COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and provide your domain details. 3. COREMERCH deploys the stack on Cloudflare Pages and configures Cloudflare Workers for backend logic. 4. Set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your crypto wallet. 5. Load your font products into the system and test the payment and delivery workflow. 6. COREMERCH hands over full access and provides 30-day support for any issues.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. COREMERCH handles deployment and configuration. You provide your products and domain. They deliver a fully operational system. If you’re not technical, you can hire someone to manage the stack for you after deployment.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and stablecoins on BSC, Solana, and TRON networks. These networks are recommended for their low transaction fees (under $0.10 per transaction).
How does file delivery work?

Once payment is verified on-chain, Cloudflare Workers generates a secure download link and sends it to the buyer’s email. The file is stored on Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, depending on your stack configuration.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If it does go down, your stack will retry payment verification automatically once the service is restored. Since you own the code, you can also integrate a backup payment processor if needed.
Can I add more products after deployment?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed to scale. You can add or update products yourself through the Supabase dashboard or by editing the Cloudflare Workers backend logic.
